newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia shares fall slightly by close.
newsitem.headline: Latvia shares fall slightly by close.

text.p: Latvian shares ended slightly lower on Monday though turnover climbed slightly amid slack summer activity, dealers said. The bourse index ended at 387.71 from 388.64 on Friday.
Total turnover was a touch at 76,000 lats, compared with 57,000 lats on Friday.
The Rietumu Bank index was down 0.2 percent to 152.37.
Most leading companies have now reported their first-half results but dealers say that the market is not expected to liven up until the autumn and the end of the summer period.
"I dont see any particular reason why it would become more active but it tends to become busier in the autumn," said one broker.
The most-traded share was Riga Transport Fleet, turning over 24,800 lats and addding one santime to 1.31 lats.
Unibanka came in second place in the activity chart, on trade of 14,800 lats. It lost two to 3.33 lats.
Other active shares included Valmiera Glassfibre on 8,100 lats but it was unchanged at 1.37 lats.

But dealers said that most of the official list shares, including Kaija, Staburadze, Unibanka and Riga Transport Fleet, offered fairly good value at present levels and that at some point in the future the market would pick up.
